Rules:
- Propose at most 3 things, the most valuable first. Cite the ids of the facts each one relies on.

proposal.summary: The data bundle upsell has a clearly positive past lift (+0.93 points, 95% +0.76 to +1.09) on SMS, and no segment cut is clearly different from the rest, so there is no basis to narrow or exclude. Recent contact pressure is noteworthy: 14% got a campaign in the last 7 days and 49 lines already had 3 or more campaigns in 30 days.

proposals.title: Keep the audience as it is
proposals.rationale: No segment is clearly different from the other lines for data bundle upsell, so narrowing or excluding would not be supported. The SMS channel matches the past data upsell results, and the audience already has a positive past lift. Consider the contact pressure: 2,537 lines (14%) got a campaign in the last 7 days and 49 lines already had 3 or more campaigns in the last 30 days, so checking these before sending is advisable.
